digest.component_or_area: Claude Code MCP tool search configuration
propositions: Serena symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before first use while other tools like Bash have zero discovery friction
The ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH environment variable is the only deferral control; it is all-or-nothing global with no per-tool or per-MCP-server granularity
Loading all Serena tool schemas (~25 tools) to keep navigation tools resident costs a minimum 25k tokens in token overhead, or up to 64k tokens on hosts with multiple connected MCP servers
A tracked .claude/settings.json with appropriate .gitignore negation can enable always-loaded tool schemas without code changes, with a one-line revert documented in local-dev-env.md
